basics.name: Alyssa Player
basics.label: Data Scientist
basics.summary: Data Scientist and Biologist seeking opportunities in the digital marketing, media, and entertainment industries, as well as visual and online design platforms.

work.name: California Institute of Technology
work.summary: Research and laboratory management for the Beacon Opto-Fluidic Platform.
highlights: Execute high-throughput antigen reactivity screening (~20k samples/run) on the Beacon Opto-Fluidic System, contributing to discovery of novel therapeutic candidates
Build and manage JavaScript-automated data-entry templates in Google Sheets/Excel, saving a 3-person team ~3 hours per session and substantially reducing data entry errors
Produce data visualizations and scientific graphics for manuscripts, academic posters, and the Beacon Center web platform using Prism, BioLegend tools, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and PowerPoint
Serve as primary client contact, facilitating biweekly meetings and translating findings into actionable project updates

work.name: Vantuna Research Group, Occidental College
work.summary: Undergraduate Research Assistant and Student Mentor.
highlights: Completed an independent Honors Thesis applying GLMMs and BACIP models in R to analyze climate-threatened reef species across the Southern California Bight
Processed and performed QA/QC on a 20-year longitudinal dataset for government-funded reef monitoring projects, producing annual ecosystem performance reports
Mentored 5-10 new students per semester in experimental design and data collection
Trained on substrate population transects on SCUBA to collect field data for annual quantitative population surveys

Collaborated with the Discovery Bay Marine Lab, Jamaica as a Richter Trust Scholar on a two-week data collection trip for an ongoing reef monitoring/ coral restoration project to observe annual organismal growth and recruitment to the reefs

volunteer.organization: Green Labs, California Institute of Technology
volunteer.summary: Assist hands-on ad outreach initiatives to educate the Caltech research community on sustainable practices and waste diversion strategies.
Serve as a STEM pen-pal mentor to inspire curiosity and expand a young student's perspective on the scientific profession.
